basics.name: Reginald "Buffer" Overflow
basics.title: Site Reliability Engineer & Professional Yak Shaver
basics.summary: Battle-hardened SRE who treats pagers as personal enemies and error budgets as sacred scripture. Fluent in turning 3 a.m. incidents into tidy runbooks and turning flaky tests into former flaky tests. Believes the best on-call shift is the one nobody notices.

highlights: Slashed mean-time-to-recovery from "eventually" to 11 minutes by rewriting the incident runbook nobody had read since the Obama administration.
Herded 240 microservices into a coherent SLO framework, reducing false-positive alerts by 83% and reclaiming the on-call team's will to live.
Automated toil away with Python and Ansible, eliminating roughly 15 hours a week of humans copy-pasting YAML into the void.
Built CI/CD pipelines so reliable that deployments became boring, which is the highest compliment a pipeline can receive.
Containerized a legacy monolith held together by cron jobs and prayer, cutting cloud spend by 41%.
Introduced infrastructure-as-code, retiring the sacred 'do_not_touch.sh' script and its 400 lines of undocumented mystery.

education.field: Computer Science (Minor in Rubber Duck Debugging)
details: Senior thesis: "It Works On My Machine: A Reproducibility Crisis."
